Services

Make AI fit your security boundaries.

We assess the execution path, add protection around inference, and build focused AI systems around real organizational requirements.

01

AI Security

Understand where an AI system can reach, what it can expose, and which actions need stronger control.

  • Agent, identity, and permission review
  • Data exposure and prompt-injection analysis
  • Tool-use and downstream-action boundaries
  • Auditability, recovery, and response gaps

02

Secure Inference

Secure Inference means protection and policy controls around inference: what data enters, which approved model receives it, and what actions may follow. It is not a claim of confidential computing or cryptographic proof of model computation.

  • Pre-inference data protection
  • Approved routing and model access
  • Permission and policy enforcement
  • Controlled output and action boundaries

03

Custom AI

Build or fine-tune a task-specific model around your requirements, data boundaries, deployment environment, and evaluation criteria.

  • Use-case and data-readiness definition
  • Model selection and fine-tuning
  • Evaluation against agreed requirements
  • Deployment with explicit security controls
